From the Hanabi demo, Jack Heart: "and also a little confused tbh what run does ... run does training? or all 3", then "i feel like it should be etude traine hanabi". Rename the local training command `etude run FILE` to `etude train FILE` (trains on this computer; eval/report/launch/smoke unchanged). "run" stays a noun (a training or eval run). Update docs/hanabi.md, docs, help text and tests; no alias needed since etude run is unreleased on this branch. Words in scratch/demo-hanabi.md. Naming flags (--name vs --run/--job) still being discussed in the demo: do not change them yet.
